description: This file defines an interface for distributed cache clearing operations within the Apache OFBiz framework. It declares methods for clearing cache lines based on different criteria, such as specific values, flexible entities, conditions, primary keys, and for clearing all caches.

classes.name: DistributedCacheClear
classes.description: Interface defining methods for clearing distributed caches in OFBiz

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Sets the delegator and user login ID context for cache clearing

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLine
methods.description: Clears cache line for a specific generic value

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLineFlexible
methods.description: Clears cache line based on a flexible generic entity

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLineByCondition
methods.description: Clears cache line for entities matching a specific condition

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLine
methods.description: Clears cache line for a specific primary key
